entities.summary: Eugenia Oleksandrivna Tymoshenko is a Ukrainian entrepreneur, philanthropist and activist who is founder and president of Child.ua, a non-profit organization. She is the daughter of former Ukrainian Prime Minister Yulia Tymoshenko.
